events.name: Salesforce surges 20% on Q2 beat, Anthropic deal
Analysts raise Salesforce price targets post-Dreamforce
BofA double upgrades Salesforce to Buy

9.text: Salesforce was upgraded to Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy) as FY2027 earnings estimates rose 24.9% in three months, with analysts' mean price target of $286.94 implying 26.3% upside. ETFs sold a net $15.2 million of the stock on Nov. 2, while its AI business grows triple digits amid replacement fears.

7.text: Wedbush’s Dan Ives calls Salesforce and ServiceNow AI winners, citing installed customer bases, while Chamath Palihapitiya says AI labs won’t first displace them. ServiceNow fell 34% last week amid a broad software sell-off; Salesforce was largely mentioned only in passing.

13.text: Salesforce agreed to acquire Braze for $47.50 per share in cash, pushing Braze stock up about 7%. Braze also announced it will report fiscal third-quarter 2027 results.

11.text: Salesforce agreed to acquire voice AI company Cresta, while Copado acquired Valo.ai and Accounting Seed released research on AI in finance. Other articles mention Salesforce in market reports on AI automation and governance, or involve former Salesforce staff.

14.text: Salesforce’s record quarter may carry a hidden risk, while the other articles focus on Adobe, Microsoft, Zoom, Atlassian, Strategy, and ServiceNow rather than Salesforce.

4.text: Salesforce closed at $226.18, down 1.3%, with EPS projected at $3.43 and revenue at $11.46 billion; shares rose 22% over six months. It filed a shelf registration for 609,118 shares (~$139.6 million) tied to an employee stock plan, and fell Friday amid a software sell-off and an S&P credit downgrade.
